title: Intent
description: Output contract of the agent's AI reader (agent/ai.js, backed by Ambiguous assistant/chat). The model is prompted to return this shape as raw JSON; extra fields are tolerated since LLM output is additive.

jobRef.description: which of the texter's active jobs they mean, resolved against the context block: a job id, a title fragment like 'sprinkler', or a time like '2pm'

question.description: for clarify: the short question to text back

say.description: model-drafted reply text for clarify/other; one or two SMS-length sentences, no promises of action

description.description: what the job is, e.g. sprinkler repair

slotChoice.description: 1-based index into a pending proposal's options
